g.text: FlareRank2Convo3 begins.
knock knock
Who's... there?
Flare...?
Lizzie...?
+5 Chemistry
you think so?
ooooh We like You, You learn QUICK don't You...
Flare. Definitely Flare.
I'm so confused.
I don't know.
Lizzie. Definitely Lizzie.
mmmm... They just couldn't help but run Their pretty little mouth and tell you all about Us
would you prefer that?
poor space traveler
and what if it is?
sooooo We thought We should come by and introduce Ourselves... properly
one body. two minds
what don't you understand?
Hello, Lizzie.
certainly of all people, that wouldn't be so straange to You...
Hellooooo...
Nope. Talk to me when Flare is back. I'm out. [End.]
We have a question for You
what... are You afraid of little old Us...? ;)
A Very Important One
+20 Chemistry
Do You...
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank3Convo1.
Love Us...?
No. The Infestation is a necessary evil, nothing more.
Yes. The Infestation is a part of all my Warframes. So... I suppose I do.
Maybe. The Infestation is a part of my life, but I don't know if I can trust it.
Is That So...?
Good... That makes Us happy to hear, Sugar
SILLY DEMON. Confusing TRUST with LOVE.

We Love You. We want You to know that. We have watched You and Loved You through the Centuries...
but We will accept that... for now. We will ask again, someday, Sugar
Update boolean FlareJumpScare
How so?
Really? The hordes of techrot and Infested that are always trying to kill me say otherwise.
+20 Chemistry
We breathe for You. Bleed for You. Feed for You. Is this demon pleased?
And do Your white blood cells not attack You when You are Sick?!
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank3Convo1.
Just when I thought this couldn't get any weirder...
You're the Helminth?!
We are Many. We are the Forever. We are Throughout Time. We are the All. Forgive us the Few we Do Not See.
Mmmmhehehehe... poor Demon... made of stolen fingers and Infested Toys...
We Are All And We Are One
once Alone, Alone no longer
but fear not
We are so Happy for You
We. Love. You. And Always Have
so this is why We are asking You... no... BEGGING YOU....
this one is OURS
Let Us Have Them...
pretty pretty please....?
What do you mean "have" them? Like the madness takes the other Warframes?
Not without them being on board.
I... I can't. I'm sorry. I can't let you "have" Flare.
Noooo!! Of COURSE not!!! We Cannot do such a thing to Them. Not with the way the Doktor Has Done It
Then you must talk to Them. Convince Them that we mean Them no harm!!
NO. THEY ARE OURS. YOU CANNOT LET THEM SILENCE US!!!
But neither do We wish to Leave Them!!!
If you plan to make them go mad like you do other Warframes...
I don't know. Eating their soul seems pretty harmful.

{"Id":2617,"Incoming":[629],"Outgoing":[633],"GraphPos":[12309,6873],"Script":{"Script":"/Lotus/Scripts/1999/HexSyndicateDialog.lua","Function":"SetupJumpScare","_dogTagSyndicate":"","_dogTagSyndicateDialogueWRes":"","_lichWeaponsManifest":"","_lichWeaponVendorCurrencyType":"","_arthurDialogue":"","_amirDialogue":"","_aoiDialogue":"","_eleanorDialogue":"","_lettieDialogue":"","_quincyDialogue":"","_dialogueWRes":"","_marieDialogue":"","_roatheDialogue":"","_lyonDialogue":"","_greetingTransmission":"","_onYourMindTransmission":"","_togetherResponseTransmission":"","_breakUpStartTransmission":"","_goodbyeTransmission":"","_breakUpTransmission":"","_breakUpUnsureTransmission":"","_kissCinematic":"","_cinematicInputFilter":"","_breakUpFadeTimer":1,"_breakUpFadeSound":"","_breakUpEasterEggChance":0.02,"_breakUpEasterEggSound":"","_questRankLimit":3,"_questKey":"","_npcAvatar":"","_actionInst":"","_cameraSpotInst":"","_avatarAnimations":[],"_avatarPositionWaypoints":[],"_actionPositionWaypoints":[],"_cameraSpotPositionWaypoints":[],"_doorPortalPortForwarderTag":"","_nodeIntro":"","_transmissionIdleDelay":[20,25],"_dioramaDisplayPurchases":[],"_dioramaDisplays":[],"_dioramaCue":"","_dioramaSound":""}}
Do not Let Them Silence Us!!
WE DO NOT MAKE THEM EMPTY
WE NEVER SAID ANY SUCH THING
Update boolean FlareJumpScare
TALK TO THEM FOR US. WE LOVE YOU. PLEASE. YOU MUST DO THIS FOR US
THAT. IS. NOT. OUR. FAULT.
+20 Chemistry
Fine...
I... don't know... I'll think about it.
I'll talk to Flare...
Update boolean FlareLizzieNoFault
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank3Convo1.
+5 Chemistry
thank You thank You, Our sweet Sugar
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank3Convo1.
